description: Changes one client's lead alerts: every lead or qualified leads only, whether the client gets KaiCalls product updates, and which emails and phones get the alerts. Requires write access to that client (agency owner/admin, or an operator assigned to it, who is also an admin on the client's account). Recorded in the client's change history. Sends nothing.

alertEmails.description: Comma-separated emails that get lead alerts; empty or null clears them.

alertPhones.description: Comma-separated phones that get lead alert texts; empty or null clears them.

kaicallsUpdatesEnabled.description: Whether the client gets KaiCalls product and account updates; null for the default.

leadAlerts.description: 'qualified' (only leads scored 70 or more), 'all' (every real lead) or 'default'.

name: agency_clients_set_client_alerts
title: Set A Client's Lead Alerts
